portfolio_timing_structure.interpretation_for_hyro_minimum_days: The five-day requirement is not structurally impossible before notional/PnL qualification is applied. Exact qualification remains sizing-dependent and is therefore not adjudicated here.

hyro_inactivity_precheck.official_rule: Account disabled if most recent trading day is older than 30 days; trading day is the last day a trade was fully closed.
hyro_inactivity_precheck.why_not_final: A challenge may hit its target and transition state before a historical inactivity gap, depending on frozen risk sizing and target progression. Those outcomes remain behind the official risk-grid/prop-emulation gate.

hyro_minimum_notional_structural_math.interpretation: At the median DH-03 stop width, approximately 0.30% of account equity per 1R is required merely for position notional to reach 5% of initial balance. This is structural algebra only; no frozen grid cell has been executed or selected and no qualifying-day result has been opened.

concurrency.implication: Any later prop emulation must enforce drawdown, margin and notional limits portfolio-wide rather than trade-by-trade.
